📝 Overview:
You+Me – Against the World is a French romantic drama about two students from very different backgrounds whose lives become intertwined while working together on a student film.

💫 Main Characters:
• Alma Lancaster — Vittoria Di Savoia
• Vadim Arcadi — Lucas Barski
• Basile Lancaster — Aymeric Fougeron
• Clémentine — Zoé Garcia
• Timothé Vallas — Léo Legrand

📖 Story:
Alma Lancaster comes from a wealthy family who believe she is studying law, but secretly she wants to pursue filmmaking. When she is forced to collaborate with Vadim Arcadi, a rebellious student with a troubled past, the two initially clash before gradually growing closer.

Their relationship becomes complicated when hidden secrets and an unknown threat put pressure on them, testing their trust and their connection. 

🎥 Crew:
• Director: Manon Gaurin
• Writers: Manon Gaurin, Eliane Vigneron & Alix Letribot
• Production: Trésor Films / Amazon MGM Studios

📅 Release: 18 September 2026
⏱️ Runtime: About 1 hour 33–34 minutes
🌍 Country: France
🗣️ Language: French
🎭 Genre: Romance • Drama
📚 Based on: Emma Green’s young-adult novel trilogy

✨ Highlight:
At its heart, the film is about Alma and Vadim choosing each other while dealing with family expectations, secrets, and the pressures surrounding their relationship.

#BABYMONSTER BABYMONSTER's vocals are why people call them the best vocal group of 5th gen — YG actually built them like a vocal group first, dance group second.

Their vocal line is insane: *Rami, Rora, Ahyeon and Pharita* are the main leads, with Chiquita also strong.

If you break it down by technique, fans rank it like this — *Vibrato: 1. Rora 2. Ahyeon 3. Rami*, *High-Notes: 1. Rami 2. Ahyeon 3. Pharita*, *Low-Notes: 1. Rami 2. Rora 3. Chiquita*, *Belting: 1. Ahyeon 2. Rami 3. Pharita*, *Support Quality: 1. Rora 2. Rami 3. Chiquita*, *Harmonizing: 1. Rami 2. Rora 3. Chiquita*. 3f4c

*Rami* is widely considered the main vocalist — she has that strong voice that can carry any note with ease and went viral with her acapella pre-chorus for SHEESH on debut stage. She has the best range top to bottom, low notes to whistle attempts. f814

*Rora* was actually initially considered to be the main vocalist by YG and fans call her the sleeper vocal — she has one of the nicest R&B tones, best vibrato and support, and when Rami was absent on tour she took over Rami's parts and killed it.

*Ahyeon* is the power belter — she hit a B5 higher than the original A5 in their Golden HUNTR/X cover at 2025 MAMA, and her early cover of Charlie Puth's Dangerously has 41 million views. 6f00

*Pharita* is the clean tone — super stable high notes and emotional color, she along with Rora and Ahyeon performed as HUNTR/X and was praised for solid vocals & clean high notes in that super demanding song. fccd

What makes them special is they can all actually sing live on radio, YouTube, and music shows without backing track — that's why even vocal coaches react positively to them, and why MONSTIEZ always say BABYMONSTER is gaining attention at a rapid pace for their incredible vocals. f814
